translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

content: Teesinti ka Kabarre ta Gala ta Luk
Gem kol siŋji Teyopil, min awalle, gee dakina gec siirin̰ gamin kuuk kuuniy ɗo ɗatikte.
Ŋu gaarteŋ gamin-ak ar kaak awalle gee kuuk tal iŋ odinco osiiteŋgu, ŋuur-ak riyco ta gaare kaaw ta Buŋdi di.
Ampa-ak, nun oki, aldu gala taat min nu bariytu baaco samaane ta gamin okin̰co kuuk kuuniy min ɗo teesindi, nu siiriijiŋ gamin-ak rakki rakki locin.
Nu siiriijiŋ-ak asaan kii ibine seen ta garaan taat ki gastu.
Ɗubil ka Buŋdi gaara ween̰ji ka Yaaya-Batist
Ɗo wiktin taat *Herood goyiy sultan ka Zuude, gin gay satkiner rakki ŋu kolaag Zakariya. Ŋa gina riy ɗo *ger ka Buŋdi iŋ gay satkiner ku Abiya.
Daaciy, siŋti Elizabeet, ta min tamba ta *Haruun.
Zakariya iŋ daaciy, seerco, ŋu gee sellen̰ ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi, ho iŋ gelbin rakki, ŋu karmiyaag *gaanuun ka Buŋdi okin̰ji.
Kar ŋuur gay bal wee asaan Elizabeet, taar mogina ho seerco ŋu zaɓ ko tak-tak.
Ƴiriy rakki, tamba tan̰ Zakariya as gine satkine ɗo ger ka Buŋdi asaan ta kaminco.
Zakariya kat ta gal ɗo kaay a ŋa ɓaa onne *dokkanne atta ɗo *ger ka Buŋdi ar kaak gay satkiner gingiy ɗo aadinco.
Wiktin taat dokkanne onniy-ak, gee okin̰co gay goy salkiya kara.
Tala kar, *ɗubil ka Buŋdi bayniiji ɗo Zakariya ho ŋa pey ɗo meeday ta wer kaak dokkanne onniy-aka.
Min Zakariya taliig ɗubil-ak, ŋa barjiltu ho kolaw obiiga.
Kar ɗubil-ak gay kaawiiji aman : « Zakariya, dak ginenno kolaw. Buŋ cokiyit salaanen̰. Daaciŋ Elizabeet yaan̰ wee mico. Ya ta wee, kii kolin̰ Yaaya.
Adin̰ yaa gine portik aale ho gee dakina yaa aaciye
iŋ kiŋke ɗo bi ka ween̰ji.
Asaan mic-ak asa gine gay riyor tatko ka Buŋdi. Wala ŋa siya maama, wala ŋa siya argi. Min ɗo adti ka yaaco di, Ruwwin ta Buŋdi miinig ko.
Ŋa asa iyin̰ koogin ku Israyeel dakina ɗo botol ta *Rabbinco Buŋ.

Ŋaa ogirin̰ uŋji, ŋaa gine riyoy iŋ gudurre ho iŋ ruwwine ar kaak nabi *Eli gintu awalle. Ŋaa amrin̰ aginay iŋ kooginco ho ŋaa newsin̰ gee kuuk kaƴco bombo ŋuu gine gee sellen̰. Paa kat, ŋaa n̰ume gee kuuk yaa kuuniye kun̰ji. »
Zakariya telkiiji ɗo ɗubil ka Buŋdi-ak aman : « Nunu iŋ daatur, seertini ni zaɓ ko, kar maman naa ibine kadar maanna-aŋ ka seener ? »
Ɗubil-ak kaawiiji aman : « Nun ko kaak ŋu koliy Jibriin kaak peya ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi. Ŋa n̰aamintu a naan̰ iyin kabarre ta gala-anta.
Kar kiŋ gay bal aamine ɗo kaawor. Kaawor-at yaa asen di ɗo wiktinti. Ɗo saan taar-at ko, Buŋ yaan̰ sokumin̰ bin̰ nam ƴiriy taat gamin-ak yaa kuuniye. »
Wiktin taat Zakariya kaawiy iŋ ɗubil ka Buŋdi-ak, gee kuuk eraag kara gay ajbiytu ɗo taaye kaak ŋa taaytu atta-aka.
Min ŋa amiltu, biy sokume. Illa ŋa tawga iŋ pisin̰ji di. Ampaa ko, gee-ak ibintu kadar maan bayinji atta ɗo ger ka Buŋdi.
Hiyya, min kun̰ Zakariya deet kaminco, ŋu yeeptu geero.
Ba aaro, daaciy Elizabeet ictu adi. Koyin beeƴ ta cigil geer di. Ta kaawtu ɗo adti aman :
« Way, Rabbin tal kaatu. Diŋ ŋa imilduut kat sokun̰uwir min uŋco ka geemir. »
Ɗubil ka Buŋdi gaara ween̰ji ka Iisa
Adti ka Elizabeet nec ko koyin bijigiƴ, kar Buŋ n̰aamiig *ɗubiley Jibriin ɗo geeger ka Nazareet ɗo kiɗ ka Galile.
Ŋa n̰aamiig ɗo gemso rakki, siŋti Mariyam taat kaawco mat ko iŋ Yuusup a ŋuu obe. Yuusup gay, ŋaar min baa tan̰ Dawuud.
Ɗubil-ak un̰jitu ɗo werti, ŋa ooyiititi, ho ŋa kaawiitit aman : « Kaŋ aacay, ka gas barkin min ɗo Buŋdi. Ŋa goy iŋ kaŋke. »
Min Mariyam doriit kaawoy-at, ta barjiltu tak-tak. Kar ta ostu ɗo adti aman : « Taar-an gay baati maa ? »
Ɗubil-ak kaawiitit aman : « Dak ginenno kolaw, Mariyam, asaan ka gas barkin ta Buŋdi.
Kaa ice adi, kaa wee mico ho kaaji diye siŋ Iisa.
Mic-ak, siŋji asa aale. Ŋuu kolin̰ Roŋ ka Buŋ ka kuwa. Rabbin Buŋ yaaji berin̰ sees ka sultan kaak min ka tacco Dawuud.
Ŋaa goye sultan ka gee ku Israyeel doo ho meennuwiy gaasaaɗo tak-tak. »
Mariyam telkiiji ɗo ɗubil-ak aman : « Maanna-aŋ yaa kuuniye maman asaan nun ibanno misa mitko ? »
Ɗubil-ak kaawiitit aman : « Ruwwin ta Buŋdi yaake ase ho gudurre taat min kuwa yaake gootiŋke ar kelmo. Ansii ko, mic kaak kaa wee-ak yaa goye sellen̰ ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi ho ŋuu kolin̰ Roŋ ka Buŋdi.
Cokay ! Elizabeet taat min baako oki iŋ adti. Taar taat gee osiy a ta mogina din sa, diŋ adti koynay bijigiƴ ko ho taa wee mico.
Asaan ginno maan kaak pak Buŋ. »
Min pa-ak Mariyam kaawtu aman : « Nun gay riyor ta Rabbiner. Kaaw taat ki kaawiidu-an yaa ase ɗo botilti. » Hiyya, ɗubil-ak rasiita ho ŋa ɗeettu.
Mariyam ɓaati ooye ɗo Elizabeet
Menaw ŋuur-ak di, Mariyam uctu ho ta birtu sak-sak iŋ uŋti ɗo kiɗ ka Zuude ɗo geeger rakki ka dambar.
Ta un̰jitu ɗo ger kan̰ Zakariya ho ta ooyiitit ɗo Elizabeet.
Min Elizabeet doriit ooyti-at di, mic kaak ɗo adti-ak teestu awke ho Ruwwin ta Buŋdi miiniita.
Ta kaawtu iŋ gaaƴ toŋgo aman : « Min daaɗ okin̰co-aŋ, kaŋken di Buŋ barkiyiŋke ho mic kaak ɗo adke oki, ŋa barkiyga.
Nun gay waa, taat nam atan̰ Rabbiner asiin talindu ?
Talu, ɗo wiktin taat nu dorig gaaƴke di, mic kaak ɗo adir-aŋ alji gala nam ŋa awke.
Galal loke, kaŋ taat aamin ɗo kaaw taat Rabbin kaawiike a taa nece ɗo werti ! »
Kar Mariyam ictu riye aman :

content.text: « Nu ozila Rabbin Buŋ, ŋaar kaak tatiko.
Gelbiner miin iŋ galal, asaan Buŋ jilaanu.
Ŋa tal aminduwir, nun taat gay riyoy ho diŋ ŋa jaalintu.
Ka seener gay, min ƴiriyta ɓaayiy iŋ uŋti,
gee okin̰co yaa kaawe a Buŋ berdu galal,
asaan Buŋ kaak gin gudurre okintiti berdu gamin
kuuk samaan lotu.
Sellen̰ gay siŋji.
Aminduwiy goy doo ɗo gee kuuk karmiyaaga.
Ŋa gaarit gudurrey iŋ soriyay.
Ŋa totirig gee kuuk jaala ziŋkico kuwa.
Ŋa paayig sultinnay min ɗo jarɗico,
ho ŋa jaalig masaakanna kuwa.
Gee kuuk mey diyaagu, ŋa berco tee,
ho gay gamnar gay, ŋa atkiig iŋ pisin̰co orok.
Ŋa mogig
gay riyoy, gee ku Israyeel.
Ansi-ak, ŋa moyiig tale ka aminduwiy.
Aminduwiy-at, ŋa taliit doo ɗo Ibraayim iŋ tambaay
ar taat ŋa kaawiico ɗo aginiyte. »

content: Min ŋaar-ak, Mariyam taaytu wer ka Elizabeet ar koyin subba pa, kar ta yeeptu gerco.
Ween̰ji ka Yaaya-Batist
Elizabeet, min menuwti ku weendi nectu, ta weetu mico.
Mutkiyti iŋ aginiyti dortu a Rabbin tal aminduwti-ak, ŋu aaciytu iŋ taara.
Min mic-ak gintu menaw porpoɗ, kar ŋu astu ɗo *ɗukume ka seln̰ol. Zer ŋu rakji diye siŋ ku tacco Zakariya.
Kar yaaco gay kaawiico aman : « Ha’a, paaɗo ! Gii kolin̰ Yaaya. »
Ŋuur gay telkiitit aman : « Ɗo baako, ginno gem kaak siŋji pa. »
Kar ŋu kaawiiji iŋ pisin̰co ɗo tacco Zakariya aman : « Ki raka roŋji, gii kolin̰ waa ? »
Ŋaar gay inditu maan ka siirindi, kar ŋa siirtu aman : « Siŋji Yaaya. » Hiyya, gee-ak okin̰co ajbiytu.
Ɗo wer-ak, biy piltu kate ho ŋa teestu kaawe. Ŋa oziliig Buŋ.
Gee-ak kolaw un̰jiico. Kaaw-at totirtu ɗo kiɗ okin̰ji ka dambiniidi ka Zuude ho ŋu kaawa ko ɗo bi ŋaar-ak di. Okin̰co, gee kuuk doriit kaaw-at, kolaw un̰jiico,
ŋu obiit ɗo gelbinco ho ŋu ɗiytu aman : « Mic-aŋ asa gine maa gemira ? » Ka seener, gudurre ta Buŋdi goy iŋ ŋaara.
Zakariya ozila selliŋkaw ta Buŋdi
Ruwwin ta Buŋdi miiniig Zakariya takan̰ mic-aka, ŋa teestu kaawe ar nabiin̰ce aman :

content.text: « Oziliika ɗo Rabbine, Buŋ ka Israyeel
asaan ŋa mogiig geen̰ji ho ŋa jiliigu.
Ŋa imilte Gay Jilindi kaak gin gudurre
min ɗo tamba ta gay riyoy Dawuud.
An ko kaaw taat min awalle Buŋ kaawiico
ɗo nabiinnay kuuk ŋa doɓtu
ho ŋuur gay kaawiit ɗo geemir.
Kaaw-at, taar ko taat Buŋ ɗiytu
a ŋaate jilinte min ɗo adinte
ho min ɗo pise ka gee kuuk elgitenno.
Ŋa tal amindaw ta aginiyte
ho ŋa bal rawtin jamuwiy taat taɓ ŋa obtu iŋ ŋuura.
Jamaw-at, taar ko taat Buŋ togiltu ɗo tatte Ibraayim
a ŋaate jilinte min ɗo adinte
ho gii abdiyin̰ji bal kolaw.
Ampaa ko, gii gine sellen̰ ho *cawar ɗo uŋji,
ɗo menuwte kuuk ŋa beriite ɗo duniiner. »
Zakariya kaawtu pey ɗo roŋji Yaaya aman :
« Gem kol roŋji, ƴiriy rakki, ŋu asaan̰ kole
a ki nabiin̰ce ka Buŋ ka kuwa,
asaan kii ogire ɗo Rabbiner ho kiiji siyin botiliy.
Kiico gaare ɗo geen̰ji maman ŋuu gase jile
ho zunuubinnico, ŋuuco saamiyin̰co.
Ka seener, Buŋ, ŋaar tala aminduwte ho ŋa elgiite.
Paa kat, ŋaate ceerin portikuwiy
min kuwa ar pat taat cokaw.
Taa ceerin̰ gee kuuk goy ɗo gondikor ho muut eraagu.
Paa kat, ceerinti-ak yaate iyinte ɗo botol ta aapiyer. »

content: Hiyya, mic-ak maaɗiyo ho ŋa gintu bombo ɗo ruwwiner. Ŋa goytu ɗo kalaaner nam ƴiriy taat ŋa gaartu ziy ɗo gee ku Israyeel.

footnotes.text: ‛gay satkiner ku Abiya’ : Min wiktin taat Dawuud goy sultan, ŋu ɗeeɗig gay satkiner werin orok seer iŋ pooɗ (24). Ɗo wiktin taar-at, Abiya tatkaw ka gay satkiner ka porpoɗiŋkar. Kar min gay satkiner okin̰co, werco kaak rakki asgiy gine riy ɗo ger ka Buŋdi menaw peesira, kar ŋu rasit kamin ɗo een̰co. Zakariya gay, ŋaar gay satkiner min gee ku Abiya.
